seo.description: Protect you, your passengers, and your car’s interior from heat and UV damage with car tinting in Brisbane. Get a quote or visit your local Tint a Car store.

html:
With its warm, sunny climate, many choose car tinting in Brisbane to keep the heat out and to have protection against harmful UV rays. But the benefits don’t just stop there – below we list the benefits of car window tinting Brisbane with our range of films – all offering different advantages and what makes us one of the most trusted car tinting Brisbane networks.

For almost 50 years Tint a Car has been supplying Australians with all their tinting needs. In addition to car window tinting in Brisbane, we also do home and office window tinting. All our films are high quality (Government certified by ARPANSA) and are exclusive to us. We offer a lifetime warranty on most of our films and a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you’re not completely satisfied with your car tinting in Brisbane we’ll remove the tint and give you your money back. Here are the different films we have available for car tinting in Brisbane and their benefits

Benefits Of Our Films Available For Car Window Tinting Brisbane

Films available for car tinting in Brisbane:

Octane – our darkest legal tint:

  • Blocks heat, glare and 99% UV rays
  • Our darkest legal colour possible gives you ultimate privacy
  • Available in 2 shades

Black panther – high-performance tint:

  • Unprecedented heat protection
  • Exceptional UV protection
  • Scratch resistant
  • Zero signal interference with electronic devices
  • Reinforces glass for increased durability and safety
  • Reduces dangerous road glare by 63%
  • Offers better visibility & clarity

Spectre – ceramic technology tint:

  • Superior infrared heat rejection
  • Fade-resistant
  • Won’t interfere with your in-vehicle technology
  • Provides clear, uninterrupted viewing through the vehicle’s glass
  • Multiple shades to choose from

All car window tinting Brisbane installations are done by professionally trained installers to ensure they look great and last longer.

Get A Quote For Car Tinting In Brisbane Today
